candidates.proposedTitle: Git lokalnie: status, staging, commit i historia
candidates.reason: Current CONTENT has no Git lesson. The usable legacy material is small but supports a bounded rewrite grounded in official Git documentation and isolated local execution.
candidates.scope: git init, status, add, diff, diff --cached, commit and log in a temporary repository with local-only identity configuration.
requiredEvidence: exact transcript from an isolated temporary repository
risks: legacy editor workflow is unsuitable for a deterministic beginner example

candidates.proposedTitle: curl i HTTP: odpowiedź, nagłówki i lokalny JSON
candidates.reason: The published fetch article explains browser-side response boundaries, while this candidate can teach terminal inspection of one controlled HTTP endpoint without external services.
candidates.scope: GET, HEAD, response headers, status output and one JSON response against a controlled local endpoint, with explicit curl.exe syntax on Windows.
requiredEvidence: recorded local server and curl transcript
risks: overlap with the published API/fetch article
legacy examples contain placeholder endpoints and unsafe auth breadth

candidates.proposedTitle: Podstawy Pythona: wartości, warunki, pętle i funkcje
candidates.reason: Current CONTENT has no Python entry layer. The candidate can be reduced to deterministic standard-library examples and checked on two locally available Python versions.
candidates.scope: values and basic types, if, range, a small function, indentation and deterministic stdout using pure Python.
requiredEvidence: official Python language tutorial and reference
risks: a new python topic would be required only at a later publication gate
